text.description:
**Launch Event - Saturday 10th September from 11am – 12pm. Strictly by appointment only**

Located in the highly desirable village of Middleton Cheney approximately 4 miles from the well served town of Banbury is this sought after building plot with outline planning permission for a detached dwelling.

The current permission allows the successful purchaser to submit their own plans for consideration however these details show an artist’s impression of what could be built together with an example of a floorplan. The total plot measures approximately 985 sq meters (0.24 acres) with the example property measuring approximately 2700 sq ft. (The size of the property is not fixed and therefore plans can be submitted for a larger or smaller property).

Further details can be found at quoting reference WNS/2021/0555/OUT

Restrictions apply on who can purchase the building plots, for more information please contact the agent.

Full details coming soon. Please click on the video for details of this property, or for more information or to arrange a viewing, contact Elizabeth Teasdale & Nicola Loraine at the Fine & Country Rugby Office.
